stem:
The time, $T$ minutes, taken by people to complete a test has probability density function given by

$$\text{f}(t) = \begin{cases} k(10t - t^2) & 5 \leqslant t \leqslant 10, \\ 0 & \text{otherwise,} \end{cases}$$

where $k$ is a constant.

parts.label: (iii)
parts.text: Find the probability that a randomly chosen value of $T$ lies between $\text{E}(T)$ and the median of $T$.

parts.label: (iv)
parts.text: State the greatest possible length of time taken to complete the test.
